Topic.label: Synthesis and Practice: Parking Design Problems

Question: The marking line of an angled parking space is 5 m long and forms an acute angle of \(60^\circ\) with the driving aisle. Approximately how many m of depth does the space occupy perpendicular to the driving aisle? (Use \(\sqrt{3}\approx1.73\). Round your answer to one decimal place.)
Solution: Depth \(=5\times\sin60^\circ=5\times\sqrt{3}/2\approx5\times1.73/2=4.325\). Rounded to one decimal place, this is approximately 4.3 m.
